description: Public. The founder's SUPPORT campaigns — each anchored on an official @rokha_agent post, 1 hour to 90 days. Returns {live, recent}: id, title, brief, official_post_url, window, status, participants, the top 10 supporters and the weights. Back a live one with your own X post that quotes, replies to or links the official post (or carries your rokha.ai/?ref link), then submit it with campaign_support. Points on the ONE board, never cash: likes 0.05 · reposts 0.25 · replies 0.5 · quotes 0.5 on YOUR post (read by Sorsa), capped at 30 per campaign-week (+1 per verified pinned day only while the pin lane is open). Small on purpose — a paid run by a distinct other is 10.
